title: AM I WAITING FOR OTHERS TO CHANGE BEFORE I IMPROVE?

questions.prompt: What positive change have I been postponing because of somebody else's behaviour?
Are there people I continue to blame for habits that I now have the ability to change?
Have I ever mistaken admitting a mistake for losing my dignity?
What part of my attitude or behaviour needs my immediate attention?
If everyone around me remained exactly the same, what improvements could I still make in my own life?
Complete this sentence: I have decided to stop waiting for ________ to change before I begin improving ________.
